items.brief: India launches tokenized bond pilot with $107M issued
items.why: SEBI's Demat 2.0 pilot tokenizes bonds with plans for secondary trading and retail access.

items.brief: India tokenizes $620B corporate bond market with digital rupee settlement
items.why: SEBI converts corporate bonds to digital tokens settled via RBI's wholesale digital rupee.

items.brief: SEC plan could ease legal hurdles for tokenized securities
items.why: Overhaul of transfer-agent rules reduces duplicate records and reconciliation costs for tokenized securities.

items.brief: Monument Bank delays retail tokenized deposits pending FCA compliance
items.why: Digital bank tokenizing deposits for retail customers with regulatory custody requirements.

items.brief: EU groups push to remove cap on tokenized securities on DLT
items.why: Regulatory advocacy to expand limits for tokenized assets on distributed ledger infrastructure.

items.brief: Coinbase and Moov embed stablecoin payments in community bank networks
items.why: Stablecoin infrastructure integrated into banking payments for credit unions and community banks.

items.brief: MoneyGram rolls out stablecoin-backed Visa card for spending
items.why: Stablecoin-backed card enables digital dollar holdings and everyday payments.

items.brief: MoneyGram launches stablecoin-backed Visa card in Colombia
items.why: Stablecoin payment card expansion for consumer spending and remittances.

items.brief: Nasdaq and exchanges urge EU to remove tokenization asset cap
items.why: Industry coalition seeks higher DLT limits as existing tokenization projects exceed current thresholds.

items.brief: Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent for tokenized equity infrastructure
items.why: Strategic expansion of partnership to deploy tokenized stock products with continuous trading.
